name: Mt. Veeder

known.via: English Wikipedia "Mt. Veeder AVA" (redirects to "Mount Veeder AVA")

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Mount Veeder wines are typically powerful in structure.
Its Cabernet Sauvignon commonly shows briary flavors, moderate to bold tannin and herbal, floral aromas.
Thin, poor soils give small berries with intense flavor, in wines that need years of aging.

blurb.text: A Napa Valley AVA high on the steep slopes of the southern Mayacamas Mountains, with shallow, mostly sedimentary soils. Its Cabernet Sauvignon is very high in tannin and acidity, capable of long aging, and often shows a distinct mintiness.
